title: Shenzhen trilateral: Xi Jinping's 'masterclass in diplomatic theatre'
summary: Xi Jinping positioned himself as a great statesman when he met with the US president and Russia's Vladimir Putin for trilateral talks in Shenzhen this week. But while the Chinese president sparkled on the world stage, does he have anything to show for it? Seong-Hyon Lee, an associate at Harvard University Asia Center, tells us how the trilateral has come up…
